title: Cool Nashville Townhouse close to Downtown
description:
Enjoy the lap of luxury in this 4 bedroom, 4 bath townhouse with amazing views of the Nashville skyline, from the 4th floor rooftop.  Short ride to downtown.  Luxurious bedrooms with a mix of king, queens, and full sized beds, comfy mattresses, and TV’s in each room.  Upscale bathrooms, with walk in, tile showers in 3 of the 4, a bathtub in the fourth.  Kitchen and living room have a spacious open floorplan, with additional speakeasy-like den.

The space
Our townhouse is a fully stocked "home away from home".  Each guest may enjoy their own space in one of the four bedrooms or come together in the open floorplan living room / kitchen space, speakeasy space with pool table on first floor, or the rooftop deck.  You are only minutes from downtown Nashville.

The rooftop is a private space just for our guests.

There will be a 30% (of daily rate) surcharge for checkins earlier than 3:00pm and checkouts later than 11:00am.
